title: Impact velocity calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the helmet's velocity just before ground contact using v = sqrt(2gh) or equivalent kinematics.

title: Deceleration time calculation
description: Important: Correctly applies kinematics for uniformly decelerated motion to find the duration using Δx = (v_initial + v_final)t/2 or equivalent.

title: Average force magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the average force using impulse-momentum theorem (Ft = mΔv) or Newton's second law with kinematics.

title: Proper kinematics application
description: Important: Correctly identifies and applies appropriate kinematics equations for both free fall and uniform deceleration phases.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout calculations and presents final answers with correct units.

title: Sign error in deceleration
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses positive acceleration instead of deceleration in kinematics equations for the compression phase.

title: Gravity during compression
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly includes object's gravity during the compression phase despite problem stating to neglect it.
